georges-bataille.oneLineEn: Expenditure, transgression, and general economy; after Nietzsche and Blanchot.

georges-sorel.oneLineEn: Theorist of myth, violence, and revolutionary syndicalism; fills a heterodox Marxist genealogy.

gershom-scholem.oneLineEn: Founder of modern Kabbalah studies who remade Jewish mysticism with historical-philological method.

gersonides.oneLineEn: Author of The Wars of the Lord who advanced Aristotelian-Averroist tradition within Jewish philosophy.

gilbert-ryle.oneLineEn: Ordinary-language and behaviorist philosophy of mind; fills the Oxford analytic tradition.

gilbert-simondon.oneLineEn: Individuation and philosophy of technology; fills later Deleuze and Stiegler lines.

giovanni-gentile.oneLineEn: Actual idealism; fills Italian idealism and its split with Croce.

gongsun-long.oneLineEn: Warring States School of Names figure known for 'a white horse is not a horse' and name-reality debate.
keywordsEn: a white horse is not a horse

gorampa.oneLineEn: Sakya Madhyamaka systematizer whose critique of Tsongkhapa is a major internal Tibetan node.

gu-xiancheng.oneLineEn: Late Ming Donglin leader who rebuilt Donglin Academy and stressed literati public responsibility.

gustavo-gutierrez.oneLineEn: Peruvian theologian whose Liberation Theology framed Latin American liberation theology.

hakuin.oneLineEn: Edo Rinzai Zen reviver who strengthened the kōan training system.

hans-jonas.oneLineEn: Ethics of responsibility and critique of technology; Heidegger pupil and environmental-ethics prehistory.

hasdai-crescas.oneLineEn: Author of Light of the Lord; critiqued medieval Aristotelianism and revalued divine love and infinity.

he-yan.oneLineEn: Cao-Wei xuanxue figure who led Collected Explanations of the Analects and 'valuing non-being' debate.

heinrich-rickert.oneLineEn: Value-relation and cultural-science methodology; fills Weber's methodological background.

helvetius.oneLineEn: Sensationalist ethics and utilitarian prehistory linking Locke's empiricism to Bentham.

henry-sidgwick.oneLineEn: Systematizer of classical utilitarianism; technical transition in ethics after Mill.

holbach.oneLineEn: System of Nature represents French Enlightenment thoroughgoing materialism and determinism.

honen.oneLineEn: Founder of Japanese Pure Land Buddhism who reorganized the tradition around exclusive nembutsu.
